source.quote: FUSION is proud to partner with Uno-X Mobility as their official apparel sponsor for the next two seasons.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention (deal started 2025, covers 2026). The FUSION collar tag, 'FUSION TEMPO!' sleeve-cuff tags, a small back-side FUSION tag and 'FUSION' on the thighs of the bib shorts are visible in the race and replica photos cited above.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by Fusion: red jersey with the yellow Uno X band across chest and back (title sponsor, Reitan Retail's fuel/charging brand). Chest: RIDLEY (left), REMA 1000 and The J.J. Ugland Companies (right) around the UCI Women's WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor); small Uno X tabs on the shoulders and circular Ridley 'R' patches on the upper sleeves. FAXE KONDI joined February 2026 on both sleeves and the upper back; before the deal the upper back carried REITAN RETAIL (the group's own retail brand). REMA 1000 runs down the side panels and the front of the shorts; FUSION (kit maker, partner) appears as collar/cuff/back-side tags and on the thighs. Same design as the men's kit (Domestique 2026 WorldTour kits overview, 9 Jan 2026). Marked complete: women's photos (Mallorca January 2026 team photo and headshots, Le Samyn des Dames, Liège-Bastogne-Liège) and Fusion's 2026 replica jersey front/back together cover every placement; the women's jersey back is not in any photo found, so the two back entries rest on the men's garment of the same design plus the women's design match seen in every other placement.
